Name: Willy Sells More
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
Willy's Fishing Emporium Expansion Mod


What Does It Do?
[list]
[*]This mod expands Willy's shop inventory, providing players with a wider selection of fish and fishing-related items to purchase.
[/list]

Key Features:
[list]
[*]New Fish Varieties: Willy now offers a variety of fish species, each with its own unique characteristics and prices.[list]
[*]Some fish have different qualities, such as silver or gold, which can affect their selling price.
[*]Certain fish are available in limited quantities, adding an element of rarity to your fishing adventures.
[/list]
[/list]

Price Adjustments:
[list]
[*]The prices of the items in Willy's shop have been adjusted based on your friendship level with Willy. As your friendship with him increases, you can enjoy discounts on these items, making them more affordable.
[/list]

Why Should You Download This Mod?
[list]
[*]This mod enhances your fishing experience in Stardew Valley by giving you access to a wider range of fish species and fishing-related items. Whether you're a fishing enthusiast or looking for new ways to make a profit, Willy's shop now has something for everyone.
[/list]

Installation Instructions:
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod files.
[*]Extract the mod files in the "Mods" folder in your Stardew Valley game directory.
[*]Thats it, now you can play the game.
[/list]
With this mod, Willy's shop becomes a go-to destination for all your fishing needs, and it adds depth and excitement to your fishing adventures in the game. Enjoy exploring the new fish species and making the most of the adjusted prices based on your relationship with Willy!
